source.market_name: Will 10 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

market_name: Will 10 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether front-end rate futures (SOFR/Fed funds) confirm a dovish shift or whether this is idiosyncratic thin-market noise on a tail strike.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move vs 2y/10y yield moves; confirm direction consistency and rule out a supply/inflation-driven yield spike.
time_plan.2h: Look for a macro catalyst (jobs data, credit stress, geopolitical shock) that would justify emergency-cut pricing; if none, fade the signal.
time_plan.6h: Re-assess whether equities are also selling off (crisis narrative) vs rallying (soft-landing easing) to disambiguate the driver.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate whether the rate-cut repricing held into the close of the window or reversed as a stale/thin-market artifact.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 10 Fed cuts (250bps) in 2026 signals a dramatic dovish repricing, most plausibly driven by recession or crisis fears that would force aggressive/emergency easing. Falling policy-rate expectations pull front-end and long-end yields lower, lifting long-duration Treasury prices. TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for a collapse in rate expectations.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm DXY is weakening and real yields (TIPS) are falling alongside the market move.
time_plan.1h: Check gold vs dollar correlation intact; ensure move isn't a pure risk-off spike that could reverse.
time_plan.2h: Identify catalyst; distinguish safe-haven bid (crisis) from pure rate-driven bid.
time_plan.6h: Re-check whether dovish pricing persists across the curve and gold holds gains.
time_plan.12h: Assess if the gold move sustained or faded with the tail-strike probability.

predictions.reasoning: Pricing in 10 cuts implies sharply lower real rates and likely a weaker dollar plus flight-to-safety demand, all of which are tailwinds for gold. Gold is a liquid, broadly-traded proxy for a deeply dovish/crisis regime.

evidence_used: Market strike: 10 cuts of 25bps (250bps) in 2026, an extreme dovish/tail scenario
Description allowing emergency inter-meeting cuts, implying crisis-linked easing
Standard macro transmission: lower expected policy path -> lower yields, weaker USD, higher gold
uncertainty_notes: This is a deep tail strike; probability moves here are extremely noisy and may reflect thin liquidity rather than information
A move could reflect either recession fear (equities down) or benign disinflation (equities up), making equity direction ambiguous
The 12h window rarely produces 7%+ moves in these liquid proxies, so neither prediction meets the tradable threshold

llm_justification.summary: A sharp increase in the implied odds of 10 Fed cuts in 2026 signals an aggressive dovish/crisis repricing of the policy path. The most direct, liquid implications are lower rate expectations (long Treasuries/TLT up) and lower real rates plus safe-haven demand (gold/GLD up). Both mappings are directionally sensible but modest in expected magnitude and low in confidence given the noisiness of a tail strike; neither is expected to clear the 700bps tradable bar.
key_assumptions: A probability spike reflects genuine dovish repricing rather than thin-market noise
Rate-cut expectations transmit to lower nominal and real yields
Dollar weakens and safe-haven demand rises in a deep-easing scenario
failure_modes: The tail-strike move is illiquid noise and reverses within hours
The dovish repricing is driven by benign disinflation, in which case gold/bond reaction is muted
If cuts are perceived as insufficient vs inflation, yields could rise instead (TLT down)
Proxies (TLT, GLD) respond to many other drivers, weakening the direct linkage
The information may already be public/priced from prior macro data, leaving no residual move
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
